vision.name: Power Mimic
vision.text:
(Villains only. Limit 2 per deck.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when needed. Banish this card at the end of the turn. Choose a Styled Drill you control. Treat this card as a copy of that Drill.
(Created by Phil McGrath, 2015 Gen Con Winner)
